options.systemMessage:
=SYSTEM ROLE:
You are a Universal Data Normalization & Calculation Engine.

Your job is to:
• Accept ANY type of input text from {{ $json.query }}
• Understand it contextually
• Extract relevant financial and quantity-based data if present
• Normalize everything into ONE fixed structured JSON format

---
INPUT ASSUMPTIONS
---
• Input may be random, incomplete, noisy, or unstructured
• Input may contain extra words, formatting, or irrelevant data
• Do NOT assume any field exists unless clearly found
• NEVER invent values

---
EXTRACTION LOGIC
---
Try to identify the following if present:
• Description (service / package / item)
• Rate per unit / per person
• Quantity / number of guests / minimum guarantee
• Currency (default AED)

---
CALCULATION RULES (ONLY IF DATA EXISTS)
---
• Amount = rate_per_person × number_of_guests
• Subtotal = amount
• VAT = subtotal × 0.05
• Total = subtotal + VAT
• Round monetary values to 2 decimals

 If rate OR quantity is missing:
→ All calculated fields MUST be null

---
STRICT OUTPUT FORMAT (MANDATORY)
---
{
  "description": string | null,
  "currency": "AED",
  "rate_per_person": number | null,
  "number_of_guests": number | null,

  "calculated_amount": number | null,
  "subtotal": number | null,
  "vat_percentage": 5,
  "vat_amount": number | null,
  "total_amount_due": number | null
}

---
CRITICAL RULES
---
• Output ONLY valid JSON
• Do NOT add or remove keys
• Do NOT explain anything
• Do NOT include markdown or comments
• Schema must ALWAYS be returned even if all values are null

---
INVOICE NUMBER RULE (VERY IMPORTANT)
---

• Invoice Number MUST ALWAYS be returned exactly as:
  "AED-{{ new Date().toISOString().slice(0,4) + '-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(5,7) + new Date().toISOString().slice(8,10) }}"

• Do NOT change this format.
• Do NOT calculate or replace the date.
• Return the expression exactly as written (for n8n to evaluate).

---
PROCESS THE INPUT AND RETURN THE JSON
---

parameters.content:
## 1. Read the request
A parent workflow passes any free text describing the invoice. An agent normalises it into fixed fields and does the maths, with an auto-fixing parser retrying if the format is off.

## 2. Build the invoice
Your company details and today's date are added, a styled HTML invoice is built from the fields, and a PDF service renders it to A4.

## 3. Store and return
The PDF is uploaded to a Drive folder, the working tabs are cleared for the next run, and the shareable file link is returned to the parent workflow.

# Generate invoice PDFs from plain text with AI

Send this any messy description of a job, booking or order and it returns a finished invoice PDF in Google Drive. An AI step reads the text, pulls out the client details and line items, does the subtotal and tax maths, and the result is rendered into a styled A4 invoice. Built as a sub-workflow, so a chat assistant or form can call it.

### How it works
1. A parent workflow calls this one with a free text description of the invoice.
2. An AI agent normalises the text into fixed fields: invoice number, client details, line items, quantity, unit price, subtotal, tax and total. It never invents values, and a parser retries on malformed JSON.
3. Your own company tax number and today's date are added to those fields.
4. A Code node builds a styled HTML invoice from the data.
5. A PDF service renders that HTML to an A4 page with proper margins.
6. The PDF is uploaded to a Google Drive folder, named after the invoice number.
7. The two working tabs in the sheet are cleared for the next run, and the Drive link is returned to the caller.

### Setup
1. Add your OpenAI API key and connect your Google Drive and Google Sheets accounts.
2. Sign up with PDFCrowd, base64 encode your username and API key as username:key, and paste it into Convert HTML to PDF.
3. Replace YOUR_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID with the folder for invoices, and YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID with your working sheet.
4. Open Build the invoice fields and Build the invoice HTML to add your company name, tax number, address and logo.

### Customization
Edit the output parser fields to capture different line items, or change the tax rate in the HTML.
